"I'm all too scared to share it with Lady Florence.
It concerns the doctor's oath, you see......
And so, I decided to speak my mind in a hole
I secretly dug up."
NW名前指定 ジキル博士
"Back in the past, when I was still treating patients in
the \c[2]Mental Ward\c[0]...before the isolation,
I had one last patient."
NW名前指定 ジキル博士
"Poor hairy fellow was tormented by a second personality with
a warped sense of justice. He thought \c[2]killing all the prostitutes
would save the country\c[0] or some such...hahaha."
NW名前指定 ジキル博士
"I've dealt with many crazy patients in my career, but for
some reason, when I saw him, for the first time...\!
from the bottom of my heart, I felt \c[2]Envy\c[0]."
NW名前指定 ジキル博士
"Something went wrong with me back then. I threw away the
facade of a competent doctor I carefully maintained, locked
that man in an isolation chamber and used him as a test subject.\!
\c[2]If you have no will to cure yourself, it's only proper I use you.\c[0]"
NW名前指定 ジキル博士
"At last, after many years and countless experiments I've
conducted on him, I was \c[2]blessed with a transcendent drug\c[0]!"
NW名前指定 ジキル博士
"On the surface, I'd remain a virtuous gentleman, and out of sight,
I'd unleash the second personality full of lust for pleasures
most abhorrent.\! With all the responsibility on him, no one
could blame me...I didn't need to suppress anything anymore!"
NW名前指定 ジキル博士
"Hyaha, hyahaha...isn't that right, \c[2]Hyde\c[0]?

nethers have been restless. Can't wait to tear him
to pieces, can you?"
